name: InterCode
intro: InterCode 将交互式编程形式化为带执行反馈的状态化循环，并以统一 Docker 框架构建 Bash、SQL 和 Python 三个环境，分别从 NL2Bash、Spider 与 MBPP 转换出 200、1,034 和 117 个任务。
build_method: 统一 POMDP 交互合同；Docker 沙箱；从 NL2Bash、Spider 与 MBPP 转换任务；为三环境实现可执行奖励
metric: Success Rate, Error %, 平均轮数, 连续奖励诊断
modality: 文本, 代码, 结构化数据
task_type: 交互式 Bash, Text-to-SQL, Python 代码生成
eval_feature: 状态化执行反馈, Docker 沙箱, 自定义奖励, 多轮纠错
variant: 原论文 Bash / SQL / Python 三环境
task_type_en: Interactive Bash, Text-to-SQL, Python Code Generation
build_method_en: Unified POMDP interaction contract, Docker sandboxes, task conversion from NL2Bash/Spider/MBPP, and executable environment-specific rewards
eval_feature_en: Stateful Execution Feedback, Docker Sandbox, Custom Rewards, Multi-turn Error Correction
intro_en: InterCode formalizes interactive coding as a stateful execution-feedback loop and implements a unified Docker framework for Bash, SQL, and Python. The paper adapts 200 NL2Bash commands, 1,034 Spider questions, and 117 MBPP problems.
metric_en: Success Rate, Error %, Average Turns, Continuous Reward Diagnostics
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2306.14898 and the official princeton-nlp/intercode repository snapshot. The original paper formalizes interactive coding as a POMDP with natural-language instructions, code or submit actions, execution observations, state transitions, and environment-specific rewards. Its modular build contract consists of a Dockerfile, dataset, reward function, and small environment subclass. InterCode-Bash starts from 1,000 NL2Bash commands using at least four utilities, removes unsupported items, grounds ambiguous filenames and paths, updates obsolete flags, and retains 200 commands across three custom file systems plus one file-system-agnostic set. Bash reward combines output similarity, file-set changes, and MD5 content correctness. InterCode-SQL converts the 1,034-question Spider development set across 20 databases from SQLite to a unified MySQL initialization dump; its output reward uses record IoU/Jaccard scaled by adjusted Kendall tau for ordering. InterCode-Python preserves 117 MBPP prompts and unit tests and rewards the proportion passed. Gold actions must execute without error and receive reward 1. The paper compares single-turn against maximum-10-turn Try Again, ReAct, and Plan-and-Solve evaluation, reporting success rate, inadmissible-action Error %, and average turns. InterCode-CTF is a later dedicated paper extension and is documented separately.
